flags.name: Prompt API
flags.why: The Prompt API itself. It is on by default: change it only if it was switched off on this computer.

flags.name: Prompt API Multimodal Input
flags.why: Lets the model take pictures and sound, for the experimental Images & Audio checks. On by default.

flags.name: Prompt API for Gemini Nano
flags.why: Chrome 138 to 150, the Prompt API under its old name. Extensions did not need it; web pages did, before Chrome 148.

flags.name: Prompt API for Gemini Nano with Multimodal Input
Enables optimization guide on device
flags.why: Chrome 138 to 153: skips the check of the graphics chip and the memory. Removed in Chrome 154, where Chrome decides alone.

lines.otherwise: This build of the browser has the model switched off in its code. In Chromium that cannot be changed: use Google Chrome.
A policy (GenAILocalFoundationalModelSettings) forbids it. chrome://management/policy shows which.
Turn on “On-device AI” in chrome://settings/ai. That switch exists only in Google Chrome, so in Chromium this line stays false.
Chrome found no graphics chip it may use. Update the graphics driver, or use a computer with 16 GB of memory and 4 cores.
Free up disk space on the drive that holds the browser profile. Chrome does not start the download, and does not say so anywhere else.
Chrome removes the model when free space falls below this.
Error says why a download failed. “Not Installed” although disk space is enough: restart the browser and check chrome://components.
“Not Supported”: one of the lines above is false. “Pending Assets”: the model is still downloading. “Pending Usage”: nothing has asked for it yet, so press Download.
